lesson.title: Debugging from Evidence and Directing a Bounded Modification
lesson.assistance_level: Guided practice prompts and AI-executed edits; learner-owned diagnoses, boundaries, inspection explanations, regression choice, transfer decision, and limitation
lesson.note: Jeremy diagnosed an exclusive seven-day boundary from a failed known-answer case, constrained the change to an inclusive comparison, and explained why earlier hold and approval rules remained unaffected. In a different invoice-routing transfer, he independently diagnosed a precedence defect before seeing the implementation, authorized only a rule reorder, selected a regression check, and marked the corrected helper ready after all tests passed. He identified that the helper cannot detect unchanged but incorrect bank details. AI supplied fixtures, edits, execution, and evidence organization. Independent mastery and every resume-level capability gate remain unclaimed.
